decisions.question: When should the save checks run by themselves?
decisions.context: 0.101.0 runs them at each scan: when a game is shown, on Look again, and when you come back to the window after five minutes. A save made while playing is checked the next time you look at the Companion. Running them the moment a save is written would find a fault sooner, but reading a 400 MB save (a few seconds the first time) takes processor time from the game while you play.

options.label: At each scan
options.detail: As built: when you look at the Companion

options.label: As soon as a save is written
options.detail: Sooner, but it reads the save while the game runs

options.label: As soon as a save is written, only once the game is closed
options.detail: Never while you play; a save made mid-session waits until you quit

decisions.why: It never competes with the game for the processor, and you see the result when you are looking anyway
